crossRefs.note: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

translations.web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
translations.bsb: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
translations.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
translations.asv: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in their way are his delight.
